name: Ferienwohnung Eisenmann
beschreibung: The Eisenmann holiday apartment is located in a residential area on the outskirts of the municipality of Bad Häring in the Tiroler Unterinntal. The meadows and forests of the Pölven are within walking distance. The apartment has a kitchen, a bedroom, and a bathroom with shower. A balcony and a parking space at the house complete the offer. The accommodation is suitable for holidaymakers looking for a quiet base for activities in the Inntal. The train station and the outdoor pool in Bad Häring are within walking distance. The centre of Kufstein with further shopping opportunities is about a ten-minute drive away.
